candidates.locator: To Be a Christian, Q.173 — What is God’s Name?
candidates.rationale: Directly asserts that God himself is just, as part of his revealed Name and character.
candidates.chunk_text: What is God’s Name? God’s Name reveals who he is—his nature, his character, his power, and his purposes. The Name God reveals to Moses is “I am who I am” or simply “I am” (Exodus 3:6, 14). This Name means that he the lord’s prayer alone is truly God, he is the source of his own Being, he is holy and just, and he cannot be defined by his creatures. (Exodus 3:6, 14; 15:11; Psalm 99; Isaiah 5:16; 42:8; 47:4; John 8:58; Revelation 1:8)

candidates.locator: To Be a Christian, Q.106 — How does God respond to human sin?
candidates.phrase: All sin is opposed to the righteousness of God
candidates.rationale: Asserts God's righteousness as the standard sin transgresses, attributing righteousness to God himself.
candidates.chunk_text: How does God respond to human sin? All sin is opposed to the righteousness of God and is therefore subject to God’s holy condemnation; yet God in his mercy offers me forgiveness and salvation from sin through his Son, Jesus Christ, the only Savior. (Psalm 130; Isaiah 1:2–4; Micah 7:18–19; John 3:17–21; Romans 1:18–2:4; 3:24–26; 5:6–10)

candidates.locator: To Be a Christian, Q.37 — What does Holy Scripture tell us about the character of God?
candidates.phrase: righteously opposing all sin and evil
candidates.rationale: Describes God's own righteous character in opposing sin, affirming his righteousness as an attribute.
candidates.chunk_text: What does Holy Scripture tell us about the character of God? God is both loving and holy. God mercifully redeems fallen creation, while righteously opposing all sin and evil. The Lord Jesus Christ is the fullest reve la tion of God’s holy love. (Exodus 34:6–7; Psalm 145; John 1:14–18; 14:9–10; Romans 5:6–11; Hebrews 1:1–3) “the father almighty”

survivors.locator: To Be a Christian, Q.173 — What is God’s Name?
survivors.rationale: Directly asserts that God himself is just, as part of his revealed Name and character.
survivors.chunk_text: What is God’s Name? God’s Name reveals who he is—his nature, his character, his power, and his purposes. The Name God reveals to Moses is “I am who I am” or simply “I am” (Exodus 3:6, 14). This Name means that he the lord’s prayer alone is truly God, he is the source of his own Being, he is holy and just, and he cannot be defined by his creatures. (Exodus 3:6, 14; 15:11; Psalm 99; Isaiah 5:16; 42:8; 47:4; John 8:58; Revelation 1:8)

survivors.locator: To Be a Christian, Q.37 — What does Holy Scripture tell us about the character of God?
survivors.phrase: righteously opposing all sin and evil
survivors.rationale: Describes God's own righteous character in opposing sin, affirming his righteousness as an attribute.
survivors.chunk_text: What does Holy Scripture tell us about the character of God? God is both loving and holy. God mercifully redeems fallen creation, while righteously opposing all sin and evil. The Lord Jesus Christ is the fullest reve la tion of God’s holy love. (Exodus 34:6–7; Psalm 145; John 1:14–18; 14:9–10; Romans 5:6–11; Hebrews 1:1–3) “the father almighty”
